mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1000) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals a stagflationary risk that triggers equity market sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1000 and CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a contraction in the real economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential investment (RSAFS > 400,000) reflects strong household spending and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 400,000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls below 140,000 signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS < 140000.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) indicates a hawkish monetary policy cycle amid high inflation, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: During a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rebound in housing starts (HOUST > 1050) signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1050.
